gate: A project earns a standing page only when it is a named deal in the AI infrastructure leverage monitor registry with material scale and a running record of dated developments from more than one source, or when Arvin names it. Candidates that meet the scale test but are not yet listed are proposed in the daily filings memo, never auto-created.
note: Standing project pages for the leverage program. Maintained by the daily filings pull and the catalyst flow: when a filing, county record or story touches a listed project, a dated development is appended here and the page rebuilds on the next site build. Entries are dated by the event, graded as collected.

Thirteen deeds of trust dated the same day run from the Red Chiles entities and Yucca Growth Infrastructure LLCs to Fidelity National Title of New Mexico, with IRB deeds to the county, leasebacks, and subordinations naming Citibank and Goldman Sachs Bank USA.

developments.detail: Commissioners reviewed a proposed energy services agreement of $10M per year for 10 years, plus proposed credits of up to $55M per year for up to three years. Commissioners said an amendment to the IRB agreements would be required. No agreement was approved, and Oracle indicated it would reconsider the arrangement.
developments.source_label: Local press report of the commission meeting
developments.title: County reviews the proposed El Paso Electric connection

developments.detail: The Board of County Commissioners appointed 11 members to the Project Jupiter Community Monitoring Committee under Resolution No. 2026-101.
developments.title: Community Monitoring Committee appointed

developments.detail: Oracle asked FERC to expedite approval of the 17.8 mile Green Chile pipeline, about 400 million cubic feet of gas a day to on site fuel cells supplied by Bloom Energy. The pipeline timeline had slipped to February 2027. New Mexico Attorney General Raul Torrez pressed FERC to broaden its environmental review to the combined footprint of the data centre and the pipeline.
developments.title: Oracle presses FERC to expedite the Green Chile pipeline

developments.detail: After a closed session of more than two hours, commissioners voted 5-0 to authorize county management and legal counsel to notify the Project Jupiter entities of a potential breach of the IRB agreements over the proposed El Paso Electric connection and power generation plan, and to engage in discussions on a path forward. The chairman reads Section 8.4 as requiring on site generation with no utility connection. The quoted text does not expressly bar a utility connection, no breach has been established, the vote revokes nothing, and Oracle had not responded at publication.
developments.title: County authorizes a potential breach notice

stories.title: Oracle presses FERC to expedite gas pipeline for Project Jupiter

summary: Project Jupiter is Oracle's 2.5 GW data centre campus in the Santa Teresa area of Doña Ana County, New Mexico. The financing runs through county industrial revenue bonds under Ordinance 367-2025: a $165 billion authorization ceiling that reconciles as Series 2025A of $15 billion, Series 2025B of $25 billion and Series 2025C of about $125 billion. The county holds title and leases the project back to the project companies, which is why the county assessor shows no parcels in the campus parties' names. The bonds are private placements. No CUSIP, fund holder position or trade print for any Jupiter entity appears in the record, and EMMA carries no continuing disclosure for them.

Power is the contested point. The Community Benefits Agreement signed on November 12, 2025 commits the project, in Exhibit A, Section 8.4, to power itself with an onsite microgrid system. Oracle has since pursued two supply routes the county disputes or regulators have blocked: the Green Chile gas pipeline, rejected at state level in July 2026 and now before FERC, and a supplemental grid connection from El Paso Electric, which the county commission voted on October 27, 2026 to treat as a potential breach of the IRB agreements. The $165 billion figure is an authorization ceiling across the three series, not a project cost. The record holds no total project cost and no construction status beyond the reported 2028 online target.
